steps.caption: Team
steps.narration: Everyone on your team signs in with their own role. Here is what a field login sees.

steps.caption: The field role
steps.narration: Marco Delgado is on the team with the field role.

steps.caption: His permissions
steps.narration: For him, See all jobs and See prices are both switched off.

steps.caption: Signed in as Marco
steps.narration: Now this is Marco's screen, signed in as himself.

steps.caption: A shorter menu
steps.narration: His menu is shorter. There is no Messages, Invoices, Integrations or Settings.

steps.caption: Three clients
steps.narration: Home counts three clients for him. Those are the clients on his own jobs.

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: The Clients list shows only those three.

steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: And the pipeline shows only his projects.

steps.caption: Price book
steps.narration: The price book lists the work for him,

steps.caption: No prices
steps.narration: but not what each item costs. Prices are hidden from him.

steps.caption: Schedule and JobCam
steps.narration: He still has Schedule and JobCam, for his visits and job photos.

steps.caption: Back as the owner
steps.narration: Back on your own Team page.

steps.caption: The switches
steps.narration: These switches decide what each person can see and do.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find them under Team and Company, in the left menu.

youtube.title: What your crew sees when they sign in | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: See ConstructHUB CRM through a field member's login: a shorter menu, only the clients and projects on their own jobs, and totals hidden when See prices is off. Then find the switches that control it on your Team page. The walkthrough uses a demo company and demo team.
